title: Fuding Railway Station
text: Fuding Railway Station () is a railway station located in Fuding City, Ningde, Fujian Province, China, on the Wenzhou-Fuzhou Railway operated by the Nanchang Railway Bureau, China Railway Corporation.

title: Yingkou
text: Yingkou () is a prefecture-level city of Liaoning province, People's Republic of China. It is a port city of the Bohai Sea, and is the location of the mouth of the Liao River.

title: Fuding
text: () is a county-level city in northeastern Ningde prefecture level city, on Fujian's border with Zhejiang province.

title: Roman Catholic Diocese of Yingkou
text: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Yingkou/Yingkow (Latin: "Imcheuven(sis)" , ) is a diocese located in the city of Yingkou in the Ecclesiastical province of Shenyang 瀋陽 in China.

title: Yingkou Lanqi Airport
text: Yingkou Lanqi Airport (IATA: YKH, ICAO: ZYYK) is an airport serving the city of Yingkou in Liaoning province of Northeast China. It is located in Lanqi Village in Xishi District of Yingkou, about 17 km from the city center by road. The airport opened on 3 February 2016, when the inaugural China Eastern Airlines flight landed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport. The total investment for the project was estimated at CNY 8.94 billion.

title: Tongcheng Subdistrict, Fuding
text: Tongcheng () is a subdistrict of the city of Fuding, Fujian, People's Republic of China.

title: Xiapu County
text: Xiapu (; Foochow Romanized: Hà-puō) is a county in the municipal region of Ningde, Fujian, People's Republic of China, located along a stretch of East China Sea coast, with many harbours and islands. It is bordered by Fuding City and Zherong County to the north, Fu'an City and Ningde's urban area to the west, and—in Fuzhou City—Luoyuan County to the south.

title: Taimushan Railway Station
text: Mount Taimu Railway Station () is a railway station located in Fuding City, Ningde, Fujian Province, China, on the Wenzhou-Fuzhou Railway operated by the Nanchang Railway Bureau, China Railway Corporation.

title: Yingkou East Railway Station
text: Yingkou East Railway Station (IATA: YDD) is a railway station of Beijing–Harbin High-Speed Railway, in particular of both the Panjin–Yingkou and Harbin–Dalian sub-sections. It is located in Dashiqiao, in the Yingkou prefecture level city, in the Liaoning province of China.

title: Bayuquan Railway Station
text: Bayuquan Railway Station (IATA: JYQ) is a railway station of the Harbin–Dalian section of the Beijing–Harbin High-Speed Railway. It is located in Bayuquan, in the Yingkou prefecture level city, in the Liaoning province of China.
